messages:
mike: Heads-up — noticed weird negative cache credits for tenant 'Beacon' on /chat route. Dashboard shows -$1.2k for last week. Anyone else seeing this?
jamie: omg, negative credits? that's not good. is it from cache over-attribution or some grouping bug?
ashley: I queried the raw events — looks like we double-counted prefix_hits for canary routing during rollout. attaching snippet.
ashley: ```sql
-- simplified
select tenant, route,
  sum(prefix_hits) as total_prefix,
  sum(route_hits) as total_route
from cache_events
where timestamp >= '2026-01-01'
group by tenant, route;
```
jamie: ah that explains it. if prefix_hits > route_hits we were giving cache credits equal to prefix_hits -> fractional refunds.
taylor: We need a clear rule: credits should be min(prefix_hits, route_hits) so tenants don't get >100% credits when traffic shifts between variants.
alex: Agreed. But rollout/rollbacks make the denominator fuzzy. Suggest we compute credits per model-variant+route+hour and then sum.
jamie: That works. Also need to surface when credits are negative in the UI (red badge) and a 'why' link to the last calc run.
mike: UX question — do we show raw token delta and $ impact? Some PMs want dollarized view only.
ashley: show both. dollar-only hides signal. Could show collapsed view (dollars) with expand → tokens + math.
taylor: For retroactive fixes (we backfill totals), how do we display? new commits should show 'adjustment' line item in billing timeline.
alex: +1 to adjustment line item. Also we should version the calc and expose the calc version in the dashboard footer so customers can reconcile.
jamie: technical impl: I'll add a batch job that recalculates hourly credits for last 30 days and emits 'credit_adjustment' events to billing topic.
mike: timeline?
jamie: prototype by EOD tomorrow, rollout next week behind feature flag. I'll add flag gating and a 'dry_run' mode.
ashley: need to update docs for API: /billing/credits?tenant=... will include calc_version and adjustment_reason.
alex: edge case: streaming responses where prefix grows after initial request — make sure we only count prefix hits that occurred before request arrival.
taylor: good catch. add lockstep event ordering or use request_id watermarking.
billing-bot: Billing job scheduled: credits.recalc.daily started 2026-07-12T14:00Z for tenant=Beacon (dry_run=true) :gear: 
jamie: putting a short note in eng-platform#announcements when dry-run begins.
mike: thanks — let's avoid surprise billing emails. :thumbsup:
